title: NCDEX Launches 'NCDEX Nidhi' Mutual Fund Transaction Platform
summary: NCDEX Launches 'NCDEX Nidhi' Mutual Fund Transaction Platform

items: National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange Ltd (NCDEX) launched **'NCDEX Nidhi'**, an API-first mutual fund transaction platform for rural FPO integration.
